newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chechnya issues arrest warrant for rebel commander.
newsitem.headline: Chechnya issues arrest warrant for rebel commander.

text.p: Authorities in Russia's separatist region of Chechnya have issued an arrest warrant for radical commander Salman Raduyev after he claimed responsibility for two bomb attacks in southern Russia, Itar-Tass news agency said on Monday.

"Measures are being taken to find and arrest Raduyev... I think we will soon put an end to declarations which discredit the Chechen government," Tass quoted an aide to Chechen President Aslan Maskhadov as saying.
The official said the Chechen authorities did not think Raduyev was behind the bomb blasts. "All that Raduyev says is the fruit of his own imagination," he said.

Raduyev, a flamboyant but isolated figure who is not part of Chechnya's post-war separatist leadership, has several times vowed to attack Russian targets over Moscow's continued refusal to recognise his country's independence. Russia halted its military campaign to crush Chechnya's secessionist drive last August and is now locked in peace talks with the separatists.

Raduyev said in a television interview broadcast on Sunday that the explosions in Armavir and Pyatigorsk were carried out on his personal order, saying they heralded a new phase of the Russian-Chechen war.

Nearly two weeks ago a bomb killed two people in Armavir, which is near Chechnya. Two more people were killed and 20 wounded last Monday when a bomb badly damaged the railway station in the spa resort of Pyatigorsk, also near the breakaway region.
